messages:
Lana: Need a compact "pocket guide" asset for the Oct 5 benchmark webinar: hero slide, one-pager, 4 square socials, 1 long social, small infographic and a tiny decision flow.
Anya: Can you list exact sizes and formats?
Lana: Hero 1920x1080, one-pager A4 @300dpi, socials 1080x1080 x4, long 1200x628, infographic 600x900, flow 800x600. SVG for diagrams, PNG@2x for socials, source Figma.
Morgan: Visual style?
Lana: Flat illustrations, subtle gradients, brand palette v2 (navy/teal/sunrise). Friendly but technical.
Design-ops: Brand note: 16px clearspace on logo, dark/light variants, avoid unapproved gradients. I'll drop tokens.
Lana: Timeline: roughs in 3 business days, final exports 2 business days after copy lock. Prioritize hero + 3 slides.
Devon: Copy for hero and socials?
Lana: Hero: "Make inference predictable." Subhead: "Benchmark-backed ways to lower per-token cost without sacrificing quality." CTA: "Register — Oct 5" Social headline (<=90 chars): "Cut inference costs, keep latency low" Body (<=160 chars): "Join our Oct 5 webinar: actionable benchmarks and tradeoffs for serving LLMs."
Morgan: Decision flow — include micro-badges for quantized, fp16, autoscale?
Lana: Yes, badges with one-line notes. Keep icons mono outline.
Lana: Sparkline: show crossover where batching reduces cost but adds latency. Add percentage label like "-35% cost".
Anya: Scheduling 30m review tomorrow 10:00am PT to go over roughs. RSVP please.
Sam-bot: Template uploaded: https://figma.com/file/abcd-pocket-guide-template
Design-ops: Export naming: hero_launch, social_01..04, onepager_v1. Include Figma link and checklist in handoff.
Lana: No photography, all illustrated. Ping me if blocked on brand access. :rocket:
